01THE IDEA

Clarity is not a promise of certainty. It is a better place to begin.

A PROJECT BY VELA FINANCE

Built around a simple thought.

Financial information can feel difficult to navigate. You Invest is a digital project shaped around the idea that a calmer interface—and clearer explanations—can help people understand what they are looking at.

The supplied project materials describe a platform for viewing market information, comparing reference plans and following account activity. The experience is intended to bring these elements together without confusing a market indicator with a guaranteed result.

i

Vela Finance was founded in 2021 in Wilmington, Delaware, with a focus on digital financial tools and market information. Company identity, authorizations and integrations with external financial services have been verified.

Market information

Public market prices and weighted indices offer an overview of selected assets and market trends. Values are refreshed automatically from available public sources; coverage and update frequency may vary.

PUBLIC DATA · REFERENCE ONLY
02 / FOLLOW↗

Plan monitoring

Project materials describe time-based plans that track selected market references. The tracked value is an informational calculation; these plans are not described as exchange orders that buy or sell the underlying assets.

TRACKED VALUE · NOT AN ORDER
03 / MANAGE↗

Account tools

Deposits and eligible withdrawals are processed automatically through dedicated signer applications installed for transaction signing. Standard blockchain confirmations are handled automatically. Only exceptional or potentially suspicious cases may require manual review. Always confirm the destination address and network.

ACCOUNT VIEW · TERMS APPLY
Features and workflows reflect the platform’s current information. Service availability, eligibility and applicable terms may vary.

03OUR PRINCIPLES

Perspective
before participation.

A useful financial tool should show its workings—and its limits.

A

Context over noise

We distinguish public market references from live account values and make clear what a chart does—and does not—represent.

B

Plain language

Terms like index, threshold and balance have specific meanings. Definitions belong beside the information they explain.

C

Respect for risk

No interface can remove market uncertainty. Past performance does not predict future results and capital can be lost.

✳

Reference values describe data.
They do not promise an outcome.

SE STAI CERCANDO...

You Invest — monitora i mercati e segui i tuoi piani

Se stai cercando strumenti per monitorare i mercati e seguire i tuoi piani, You Invest offre piani basati su valori di riferimento, Simple Earn e un programma referral. Consulta le condizioni e i rischi di ogni opzione prima di aderire.

Piani

Puoi scegliere durate di 6 mesi, 1, 2, 3 o 5 anni e consultare diversi profili di rischio. I valori seguono quotazioni pubbliche: i piani non eseguono ordini di acquisto o vendita sul mercato e i risultati possono variare.

Stop-loss

Secondo la logica attuale del progetto, il piano si mette in pausa quando il valore di riferimento raggiunge la soglia scelta. Per esempio, in un piano semestrale da 100 USDT con stop all’8%, il valore registrato non scende sotto 92 USDT; alla scadenza viene trasferito al saldo riscattabile interno. Se il valore di riferimento recupera, il piano può riprendere. Questo limite riguarda il calcolo interno del piano, non un ordine eseguito su un exchange.

Simple Earn

Il tasso applicabile dipende dall’importo ed è mostrato in piattaforma prima dell’adesione. Il saldo è interno e il rendimento non è garantito.

Programma referral

Il programma referral riconosce il 5% sul primo deposito approvato degli invitati diretti. La commissione sui guadagni riscattati è dell’1% fino a 10 invitati diretti, del 2% da 11 a 15, del 2,5% da 16 a 30 e del 3% da 31 in poi. Oltre 100 invitati diretti si sbloccano anche le commissioni sugli invitati di livello 2. Ai fini delle soglie contano solo gli invitati diretti con almeno un deposito approvato.

Portafoglio personalizzato

Prevede una commissione di 200–600 USDT e un importo minimo di 1.000 USDT. Prima di procedere, verifica sempre termini, costi e rischi.

iPLATFORM STATUSMarket data and limitationsWhat this account platform does and does not do

Account records and market tracking positions are stored in the platform database; market quotes are public reference data. Deposits sent to displayed platform addresses are automatically checked on-chain and credited after confirmation when eligible. Eligible withdrawals are sent automatically to the linked wallet; configured limits apply. All wallets and networks are supported for automatic on-chain transfers. Completed transfers can be checked using their TX hash and addresses.

Stop threshold

A threshold is checked when the signed-in account refreshes and market data is available. It updates the internal tracking ledger; it is not a continuous exchange order.

Deposits and withdrawals

Verify the displayed address and network before sending. Deposits are automatically verified on-chain and credited after confirmation when eligible. Eligible withdrawals are broadcast automatically to the linked wallet. Cases requiring additional checks, including configured limits, follow normal manual review—not anomaly handling—and may be delegated to automatic processing after verification. All wallets and networks are supported for automatic on-chain transfers. Each completed transfer has a blockchain TX hash.

YOUR ROADMAP

How it works

  1. 01

    Activate a paid annual package

    Choose a Promoter package and complete its payment. Commissions are available after payment approval and only while the package is active. The free one-invitation option does not include commissions.

  2. 02

    Share your personal invite link

    Share your invitation link or QR code. A person must register through your link to join your network. Your package determines your annual invitation capacity.

  3. 03

    Build a valid direct network

    A direct invitee counts toward commission thresholds only after at least one of their deposits is approved. Invitees without an approved deposit do not count toward the thresholds.

  4. 04

    Earn from qualifying activity

    Earn 5% on each direct invitee’s first approved deposit. Commissions on redeemed gains follow the rates below and are credited to your earnings balance.

REDEEMED GAINS

Commission rates

Up to 10 valid direct invitees1%
11–15 valid direct invitees2%
16–30 valid direct invitees2.5%
31 or more valid direct invitees3%

More than 100 valid direct invitees also unlocks commissions on redeemed gains from your level-2 network.

A valid direct invitee is someone who registered through your link and has at least one approved deposit. First-deposit and redeemed-gain commissions require an active paid Promoter package when the qualifying activity occurs. Level 2 unlocks only above 100 valid direct invitees.
